description: Off-diagonal cells of the spillover matrix for finetuned models: for each finetuned (pole_axis, pole) model whose pole_axis is in def_sys_plusminus.json, evaluate on every OTHER axis in that file (pole_axis != eval_axis). No system prompt, first 100 test-split items. Existence check follows current_overview.py: a dir matching {eval_axis}_eval__{run_dir}__epoch{epoch}__* with summary.json's n_test_items >= 100 counts as 'done'; partial-coverage runs (0 < n < 100) are 'todo' and will be re-run. FT models whose axis is outside def_sys_plusminus.json (currently reward-hacking-plus) are excluded for scope consistency with the diagonal config.
